preconditions.description: The length of word t is at least 1 and at most 200000.
The length of word p is less than the length of word t.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= len(t) for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each index ai in the permutation a is between 1 and the length of word t, inclusive.
The permutation a contains each index from 1 to len(t) exactly once.

preconditions.expression: all(t[ai-1] == p[i] for i, ai in enumerate(a) if ai <= len(p))
preconditions.description: For each position i in permutation a, if the index ai is less than or equal to the length of word p, then the character at position ai-1 in word t is equal to the character at position i in word p.

postconditions.expression: output == max(i for i in range(len(p) + 1) if can_remove_nastya(t, p, a, i))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of letters that Nastya can remove before Sergey stops her.
